alsoChecked: The full test suite ran green in this build — 100 files, 597 tests passed (0 failed) — which is what settles the many non-visual data-model, routing, autosave and lock behaviours no screenshot can show.

The read-only Preview correctly shows status as silhouette labels (not selects) and insights as text (not textareas), with a 'Locked at —' provenance line and no dangling 'Locked by' — the locked rendering the mission asks for.
The theme is a single global 'Dark' toggle top-right with no builder-local toggle, matching the resolved decision to drop the mockup's builder toggle.
summary: This is a strong build: the whole Reviews → Collect → Builder → Preview flow is present and correct, every functional behaviour I could reach checks out, and the project's own 597-test suite passes green, settling the data-model, autosave, lock-gate and re-pull behaviours no screenshot can show. The one real issue is visual parity on the primary CTA buttons — Pull data & start, Continue to builder, Lock month and Back to builder all render an oversized icon that spills past the button with the label wrapping to 2-3 lines, where your mockup draws compact single-line buttons with a small inline icon. Nothing is broken by it and the flow completes, so I'd ship with that button styling logged as a known fix.
